title.en: Exempting From All Taxes the Earnings of Investments of the Foundation for Youth Development in the Philippines, Inc.

text.en:
Any provision of existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding, the earnings of the Foundation
for Youth Development in the Philippines, Inc. from its investments and bank deposits shall be exempt from
any and all taxes to which they are otherwise subject.

All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent herewith are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
